scripts.deploy: npm run build && rm -rf "$TMPDIR/ghp" && git worktree prune && git worktree add -q "$TMPDIR/ghp" gh-pages && rsync -a --exclude .git dist/ "$TMPDIR/ghp/" && cd "$TMPDIR/ghp" && git add -A && git -c user.name="Jonathan Leal" -c user.email="jonlealfinances@gmail.com" commit -qm "Deploy site" ; git push origin gh-pages; cd - >/dev/null; git worktree remove -f "$TMPDIR/ghp"
